title: Keep the attention completion journey within its timeout under load

intentCoverage.report:
**Verdict.** Caught.

**Next proof action.** None for this promise on the backlog-card path. The maintained text assertion already fails on the observed wrong message text. Leave any test change with the caller.

**Story.** SEED-341#keep-attention-completion-journey-within-timeout, section "Keep the attention completion journey within its timeout under load" in `.planning/seeds/SEED-341-simplify-session-tests.md` (anchor `keep-attention-completion-journey-within-timeout`). Plan: `.planning/slice-plans/776-keep-attention-completion-journey-within-timeout/PLAN.md`. The suggested promise was kept. The story's key example says a composed attention completion's story card shows the message as text (the script tag is not an element). At this revision the page owner `dashboard/src/SessionAttentionMessage.tsx` renders `report.message` as a React text child of the attention-message `pre`, and `attentionMessage` in `dashboard/test-support/support/composedAttentionPage.ts` is `Publication finished. Reminder: inspect the migration before release.\n<script>must remain text</script>`.

**Revision.** `fa069ef75dce5b7566f69b9a53d8f365222e3a86`, detached scratch checkout created with `git -C /Users/terryyin/git/open-dough/.worktrees/keep-the-attention-completion-journey-within-its worktree add --detach /tmp/dough-intent-coverage-attention fa069ef75dce5b7566f69b9a53d8f365222e3a86`. Pre-probe status: `HEAD (no branch)`, `nothing to commit, working tree clean`, porcelain empty. `node_modules` was a symlink to the execution worktree's `node_modules`. `npm install` was not run. The e2e command built the dashboard into its temporary artifact. No separate dashboard build was made.

**Fault.** Kept the suggested fault. In `dashboard/src/SessionAttentionMessage.tsx`, the attention-message `pre` no longer had the text child `{report.message}`. It had `dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: report.message }}`. React 19.3.1 assigns that with `domElement.innerHTML`. The page spec's assertions and fixtures were left unchanged.

**Checks.** From the scratch checkout, with `PATH` including `/opt/homebrew/bin` and `NO_COLOR`, `FORCE_COLOR`, and `GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES` unset:

`caffeinate -s -i npm run test:e2e -- e2e/sessions/agent-completion-attention-page.spec.ts -g "the backlog card shows a composed Codex attention completion"`

A line-reporter `--list` of that filter selected one test: `sessions/agent-completion-attention-page.spec.ts:66` `the backlog card shows a composed Codex attention completion`. Baseline before the fault exited 0. The quiet reporter printed nothing, which is its passing result. With the fault, the same command exited 1. After restoration, the same command exited 0 and the quiet reporter again printed nothing.

The catching assertion is `expect(messagePartOf(card).text).toHaveText(attentionMessage)` at `e2e/sessions/agent-completion-attention-page.spec.ts:83`, in the step "Then the backlog card shows that message as text". The received text was `Publication finished. Reminder: inspect the migration before release.` The expected second line was `<script>must remain text</script>`. The expect timed out at its printed 5000 ms. The script-count assertion at line 84, `messagePartOf(card).part.locator("script")` with count 0, stayed unexecuted.

**Reach.** The locator resolved to the backlog card's attention `pre`: region "Board", region "Backlog", article "Story B", `.session-attention-message`, region "Attention message". The call log recorded 14 resolutions to `<pre tabindex="0" role="region" aria-label="Attention message">`. The failure frame snapshot shows that `pre`'s text node as `Publication finished. Reminder: inspect the migration before release.\n`. The stored completion in the trace still carries the full `attentionMessage`, including the script tag characters. The test opened the composed backlog card and read that message part.

**Wrong behavior.** On that card the attention message was the sentence before the tag. The literal `<script>must remain text</script>` was absent from the region's text. Playwright's `toHaveText` uses `elementText`, which skips `SCRIPT` nodes, and its frame snapshot also skips `SCRIPT` nodes, so the failure record contains no script count. In this same Chromium, assigning that same message with `pre.innerHTML` produced child nodes `#text` and `SCRIPT`, one `script` element whose text is `must remain text`, and `innerText` equal to the sentence the card showed. That is the assignment React's `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` performs, and the card's received text matches it.

**Prior disposition.** Slice 1 of the plan is done. Its recorded discrimination, later reverted, was a scratch edit that drops the composed message and makes the message assertion fail. Source review C19 records that `toHaveText` failed when the message was dropped. This probe used HTML insertion of the same message. It does not match an open repair, and it makes no repair decision.

**Restoration.** The fault command's EXIT trap ran `git restore --source=HEAD --worktree -- dashboard/src/SessionAttentionMessage.tsx`. Before the restored rerun, porcelain was only `?? node_modules`, `git diff` was empty, and the attention-message source matched `HEAD` at `fa069ef75dce5b7566f69b9a53d8f365222e3a86`. The restored command exited 0. Removing the symlink left `nothing to commit, working tree clean`, porcelain empty, the same revision. Ignored `e2e/test-results/` remained. `git worktree remove /tmp/dough-intent-coverage-attention` succeeded without `--force`. The scratch worktree is gone. Nothing was committed or pushed. The execution worktree was left unmodified; its existing untracked diagnosis note was left in place.

**Test runtime.** Measured command wall clocks. The quiet reporter printed no run duration. Each figure includes npm startup, global setup, and the run's dashboard build.
- Baseline, exit 0: 9717 ms, from 1795390095582 to 1795390105299.
- Fault, exit 1: 10555 ms, from 1795390155489 to 1795390166044. The failing expect's printed timeout was 5000 ms.
- Restored, exit 0: 12349 ms, from 1795390282127 to 1795390294476.

**Human effort.** Unavailable. No separate human-time record was kept for this check.

**Agent effort.** Unavailable. This session has no agent-effort meter separate from the invocation clock.

- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 407248 ms (measured), from 1795389929869 to 1795390337117 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

## Wrap-up disposition

Checked revision fa069ef75dce5b7566f69b9a53d8f365222e3a86. Verdict: Caught. No follow-up.
